title: In the Presence of Danger
coreMove: Treat a refused boundary being pressed again as information and move before social proof catches up.
sourcePressure: A real present cue deserves more authority than the social pressure to seem agreeable; Kelly carrying groceries upstairs is the frozen source case for how insistence after refusal can turn politeness into danger.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing fear to general anxiety or teaching readers to be suspicious of everyone.

sourceAnchors.name: Kelly
sourceAnchors.detail: Frozen notes identify Kelly as the opening case: she is carrying groceries upstairs when a man insists on helping after she has already refused, and later realizes she is in immediate danger.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Kelly had already said no to help with the groceries; the danger began when that no had to keep defending itself.
